detaileddescription.para: Power-good / ALERT line masks, indexed by pwrPgLine_t.
Sticky fault shadow: DIAG_ALRT clears on read, the application must not.

briefdescription.para: Merges the device diagnostics into the sticky fault shadow.

detaileddescription.para: Under-voltage and under-current flags are ignored because those limits are programmed to non-trippable values (see PWR_MON_UV_DISABLED_V and PWR_MON_UI_DISABLED_A).

parameterdescription.para: Decoded DIAG_ALRT flags of the device.

simplesect.para: Non-zero if at least one fault bit was set in flags.

briefdescription.para: Queries all monitors of one power-good group.

parameterdescription.para: Power-good / ALERT net whose monitors are queried.

simplesect.para: Number of devices that reported a fault, or -1 on a device error.

briefdescription.para: Creates all device handles (regulators and monitors).

detaileddescription.para: No bus traffic, no device configuration. Requires i2cBus_init() to have succeeded.

simplesect.para: PWR_OK on success, PWR_E_INIT if a handle could not be created.

briefdescription.para: Writes control register and voltage setpoint of both FMC Vadj regulators.

detaileddescription.para: Outputs stay disabled. The setpoints are taken from BOARD_FMC1_VADJ_V / BOARD_FMC2_VADJ_V.

simplesect.para: PWR_OK on success, PWR_E_INIT if not initialized, PWR_E_RANGE if a configured setpoint exceeds BOARD_FMC_VADJ_MAX_V, PWR_E_DEVICE on a device error.

inbodydescription.para: < Hard upper bound for both FMC Vadj rails [V].

briefdescription.para: Checks whether the regulator reports a valid output voltage setting.

simplesect.para: PWR_OK if the voltage register reads back the programmed value, PWR_E_PARAM if fmc is invalid, PWR_E_INIT if not initialized, PWR_E_DEVICE on a device error, PWR_E_REGULATION on a mismatch.

briefdescription.para: Enables/disables both FMC Vadj regulator outputs.

parameterdescription.para: Non-zero to enable, zero to disable.

simplesect.para: PWR_OK on success, PWR_E_INIT if not initialized, PWR_E_DEVICE on a device error.

detaileddescription.para: ADC configuration, over-voltage, over-current and over-temperature limits, latched alert, and a clearing read of DIAG_ALRT.

simplesect.para: Call order matters: the ALERT outputs sit on the power-good nets, so this must run after boardGpio_waitSomReady() (a latched alert would otherwise keep SYS_PG low) and before the FMC supply is switched on.
PWR_OK if all monitors were configured, PWR_E_INIT if not initialized, PWR_E_DEVICE if at least one monitor failed (the remaining monitors are still configured).

briefdescription.para: Polls bus voltage, current and die temperature of a single rail.

parameterdescription.para: Receives the measurement snapshot on success.

simplesect.para: PWR_OK on success, PWR_E_PARAM if values is NULL or rail is invalid, PWR_E_INIT if not initialized/configured, PWR_E_DEVICE on a device error.

briefdescription.para: Polls all rails and prints the measured values.

simplesect.para: PWR_OK if all rails were read, otherwise the last error code.

detaileddescription.para: Only if a line is low, the devices of that group are queried over I2C; faults found are merged into the sticky fault shadow. If a line is low but no device reports a fault, the supply itself failed and PWR_E_REGULATION is returned.

simplesect.para: PWR_OK if all lines are high, PWR_E_INIT if the monitors are not configured, PWR_E_REGULATION if a line is low, PWR_E_DEVICE if a monitor query failed.

briefdescription.para: Reads the sticky fault shadow of a rail.

detaileddescription.para: Accumulated over all queries since the last clear.

simplesect.para: PWR_OK on success, PWR_E_PARAM if faults is NULL or rail is invalid.

briefdescription.para: Clears the sticky fault shadow of a rail.

parameterdescription.para: Rail to clear (invalid values are ignored).

briefdescription.para: Prints all accumulated faults of all rails.
Returns the display name of a rail, e.g. "VCCADJ_FMC1".

simplesect.para: Name string, or "?" if rail is invalid.
